scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:server" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5000/api/health && npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.db:push: cd server && npx dotenv-cli -e ../.env -- npx prisma db push
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx dotenv-cli -e ../.env -- npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:studio: cd server && npx dotenv-cli -e ../.env -- npx prisma studio
